verdict.rationale: Helix Cloud documents role-based access control and scoped API keys (read-only, read-write, or operation-restricted) for least-privilege credentials per service or environment. Bearer tokens are managed through the dashboard, and MCP tools enforce permission scopes such as database.query.read, so an agent can be given a narrowly scoped key. Missing for 10: evidence of programmatic or CLI-based key issuance (only dashboard management is documented), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how the scopes behave in practice.
